Aisha (PM): Quick follow-up from the design sync — people reported the small help link in the Models table says 'Tag docs' but the docs page uses 'Version' and the anchor is #pinning. Causing confusion when people try to pin older builds. Dan (Design): I saw that. We slipped into shorthand 'Tag' in the UI to save space. Suggest we standardize on 'Version' in the UI and use a shorter visible label 'Version' + an explicit inline link 'How to pin a version' that targets #pinning. Rafael (Docs): Agreed on 'Version' as canonical. I'll add a tiny glossary blurb that maps 'tag' -> 'version' and add an anchor #tag that aliases #pinning for old links. Also will add an H2 id specifically for the pinning flow: #pinning. Marta (Eng): Easy to change the visible label. Two engineering concerns: (1) analytics events currently log "model_tag_click" — we'd want to avoid breaking dashboards, so let's keep the event name but update the label mapping; (2) deep links that use #tag should still resolve. We can add a static redirect or server-side alias for anchors. Aisha (PM): Perfect. Rafael, can you add the alias and a one-line note at the top of the docs page: "Console shows 'Version' (previously 'Tag')" so support can point to it? Rafael (Docs): Yep. Will add: "Note: the console label 'Version' may appear as 'Tag' in older screenshots. 'Tag' is synonymous with 'Version'." I'll add search aliases for tag/variant too. Dan (Design): Accessibility checklist: ensure the inline link has aria-label "Learn how to pin a model version" and the tooltip (what shows on hover) is focusable with aria-describedby. Also avoid truncating the visible label in narrow widths; prefer wrapping to ellipsizing. Marta (Eng): I'll add the aria-label and keep the analytics event unchanged. For the anchor alias, I can add an nginx rewrite rule to preserve fragment identifiers by redirecting /docs/models#tag -> /docs/models#pinning, but fragments aren't sent to the server. So we need the docs page to contain both ids:

and a hidden that jumps to the H2. Rafael, can you put that anchor in the HTML? Rafael (Docs): Good catch — will include the hidden anchor right before the H2. Also add a small meta note for search. Aisha (PM): QA asks: can we add an e2e that clicks the inline link and asserts the URL ends with #pinning and focus is on the H2? Also have QA test keyboard-only nav for the tooltip. Marta (Eng): Yep I'll add an e2e in the console-tests suite: navigate to Models table, click the 'How to pin a version' link, wait for #pinning, assert document.activeElement is the H2. Dan (Design): I'll upload two microcopy variants for the tooltip in Figma: succinct vs explanatory. Will note recommended a11y phrasing. ConsoleBot: release-tracker: docs-pr: queued, ui-branch: created, qa-ticket: TEST-3421. Aisha (PM): Timelines: Rafael PR today, Marta to land UI label change in next patch, Dan to finalize tooltip copy by EOD. We'll merge once docs PR approved and QA green. Reconvene if the docs anchor alias causes issues. Thanks everyone. Rafael (Docs): On it, will ping the thread when PR is up. Marta (Eng): I'll include the analytics mapping in the PR description so dashboards don't get confused. Dan (Design): :thumbsup:
